catalog.title: Create PLC: import DS point catalog
catalog.scope: Creates one PLC, including disabled points. Import does not enable, connect, collect or report. Existing origins and identities are rejected.
catalog.loopback: A 127.* loopback address works only when DS and DAA run on the same computer. Preview again after changing the target.
catalog.hashHint: The file hash identifies the selected bytes. The exporter's hash is not verified here. Neither hash proves device layout, file authenticity or network reachability.
catalog.confirmTarget: I checked the target and complete point list and confirm that descriptions will be copied to new point comments.
catalog.unknown: The commit result is unknown. Reload the draft and its source before continuing; do not retry blindly.
catalog.lockedFields: Catalog technical names and addresses cannot be overridden; display names, comments, groups and enabled state remain editable.
catalog.noTree: This is an archived JSON point catalog, not a TIA source tree. DB length and point layout are checked against the catalog.

errors.catalog_size_invalid: The file is empty or exceeds 1 MiB.
errors.catalog_file_changed: The file changed or could not be read again. Select and preview it again.
errors.catalog_encoding_invalid: The file must be valid UTF-8 without a BOM.
errors.catalog_depth_invalid: JSON nesting exceeds the limit or its structure is incomplete.
errors.catalog_format_invalid: The JSON syntax, fields or field types are invalid.
errors.catalog_metadata_invalid: Catalog version, export metadata or PLC information is invalid.
errors.catalog_connection_invalid: The client target is invalid or its TSAP is incompatible with DAA defaults.
errors.catalog_db_invalid: A DB identity, name, number, size or point set is invalid.
errors.catalog_point_invalid: A point identity, name or display field is invalid.
errors.catalog_address_invalid: A point address, BOOL bit or DB range is invalid.
errors.catalog_source_invalid: The catalog bytes, archive or hash do not match.
errors.catalog_binding_invalid: The catalog and local DB / point bindings do not match.
errors.catalog_filename_invalid: The selected file name is invalid.
errors.catalog_identity_conflict: A PLC, DB, point identity or the same file already exists; merging and overwriting are unavailable.
errors.catalog_origin_conflict: This origin already exists; merging and overwriting are unavailable.
errors.catalog_derived_conflict: Catalog point sets, technical names, addresses and types cannot be overridden.
errors.catalog_preview_conflict: The preview changed or expired; select or preview again.

unitPickerHint: Select one PLC as the current point-contract and sample-read target. Selection changes context only; it does not connect to the PLC.
endpointMultiple: {count} PLC endpoints; select one PLC for a sample read
selectOneForSample: Select one PLC for a targeted sample read.

controls.startConfirmMessage: After start, this page will read target {target} on the configured interval without writing to the database. Confirm that the PLC endpoint and driver settings have been checked.
controls.failed: PLC read failed: the target PLC may be offline or unreachable. Details: {error}
controls.failedUnknown: PLC read failed: the target PLC may be offline or unreachable.
controls.notAttempted: PLC read was not attempted. Check the read gate and target PLC configuration.
controls.notAttemptedWithReason: PLC read was not attempted. Check the read gate and target PLC configuration. Details: {error}
controls.targetRequired: Select one PLC before starting a sample read.

disabledReasons.runtime: Browser mode cannot control the local PLC runtime.
disabledReasons.readGate: The PLC read gate is closed or has a configuration conflict.
disabledReasons.busy: Another PLC sample read is in progress.

sample.pendingForTarget: No sample has been read for the selected PLC: {plcKey}

configCapability: Current configuration is read from YAML/env. View and select a PLC here; editing, connection tests and managed persistent connections are planned for later stages.
pointsCapability: Files are identified automatically. Enter each actual DB number, select blocks, then preview the delta. UDTs have no DB number. Existing blocks update only with valid source proof; renumbering, renaming or leaf removal is blocked. For changed sources, explicitly select an existing target. Unselected blocks retain their old versions.

sourceImport.help: Files are identified automatically. Enter each actual DB number, select blocks, then preview the delta. UDTs have no DB number. Existing blocks update only with valid source proof; renumbering, renaming or leaf removal is blocked. For changed sources, explicitly select an existing target. Unselected blocks retain their old versions.
sourceImport.ready: The selected set can be confirmed as a draft. Acquisition readiness still requires separate review.
sourceImport.blocked: The selected set has blocking issues. The current draft is unchanged. Deselect problem blocks and preview again.
sourceImport.preservation: Keep {points} existing points / {manual} manual addresses; invalidate {invalidated} address confirmations.
sourceImport.layoutChanged: Declaration order, type or layout dependencies changed. All address confirmations in this target DB are invalidated; address values and manual reasons are retained.
sourceImport.udtIsolation: Only selected DBs use the new UDT version. Other DBs retain the old version.
sourceImport.readiness: Existing draft readiness (advisory for structural import)
sourceImport.manualConflict: Manual address differs from the theoretical layout; its value and reason are retained.
sourceImport.layoutProfile: Profile: {profile}; complete explicitly non-optimized standard layout only. Preview does not save addresses. Confirmation changes non-manual addresses only. Field addresses require separate site verification.
sourceImport.chooseHint: Choose .db / .udt files. Cancelling keeps the previous input.
sourceImport.lengthEditHint: Length edits remain unsaved in the draft. After closing, use Save draft in the configuration bar. Closing does not save.
sourceImport.lengths: Configured DB length: {current} bytes · Calculated length: {calculated} bytes
